A scrolling list widget.

## Param: object

| Properties | Description           | Required | Type     |
| ---------- | --------------------- | -------- | -------- |
| x          | The x-axis coordinate | YES      | `number` |

### item_click_func

The callback a tap on an item invokes.

| 参数      | 说明                        | 类型     |
| --------- | --------------------------- | -------- |
| index     | Index of the item tapped.   | `number` |

### unknown_shape

| Gadget Name | Description        |
| ----------- | ------------------ |
| widget_a    | Something untyped. |
